summary: Vilas County, WI 100-foot Aermotor tower built 1934 on land Drager gave an easement for; removed by August 2023; a USGS survey marker is the only remnant described.

facts.design: 100-foot Model MC-39 Aermotor steel tower with 7-by-7-foot cab and an inside stairway
facts.status_note: Removed by August 2023 per the Former Fire Lookout Sites page (NHLR says by 2023); FFA list marks it gone

events.note: Land purchased for back taxes by Edmund and Matilda Drager; Mr. Drager later granted the government an easement for the tower
Constructed in 1934 on a small, high, wooded knob that scouts selected
Registered July 20, 2004; nominated by Keith Posto
Registered December 31, 2023; nominated by Mitchell Moore
Removed by August 2023 (FFLOS); NHLR says by 2023

evidence.quote: Constructed in 1934, this structure is a 100' Model MC-39 Aermotor steel tower with 7'x7' cab and an inside stairway.

corrections.proposed: Each register numbers the site separately: NHLR US 584, WI 3 and FFLOS US 2099, WI 4.
corrections.why: The NHLR page lists US 584, WI 3 and the FFLOS page lists US 2099, WI 4; they are two numbers for one site, not one shared number.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says removed by 2023 and FFLOS says removed by August 2023. Both agree on removal no later than 2023; the story uses the more specific FFLOS wording.

notes_for_editor: Built 1934 and removal by 2023 agree across NHLR, FFLOS and the FFA list. No account of the demolition, and no staffing or fire history, was found. The USGS survey marker photo is captioned but its image URL was not captured, so no photo entry was added. The NHLR and FFLOS 'Monahan' pages both carry a Drager ownership and easement history, which is the main new detail.
